dish.note: Ginger beer over smoky black tea, muddled ginger and lime. Say something, Michael. He never does.
dish.how: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift them out and chill the tea. Muddle the ginger slices with the lime juice in four tumblers. Fill with ice and add the tea. Top with ginger beer, stir and finish with a lime wedge.
dish.make_ahead: Brew and chill the tea up to 2 days ahead; build each drink to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift them out and chill the tea.
Muddle the ginger slices with the lime juice in four tumblers.
Fill with ice and add the tea.
Top with ginger beer, stir and finish with a lime wedge.
